entities.name: Luis Antonio Jiménez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Antonio Jiménez Camacaro is a Venezuelan former professional baseball first baseman. He played for the Seattle Mariners in Major League Baseball (MLB), the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB), and the Lotte Giants in the KBO League. Jiménez throws and bats left-handed. He is the hitting coach for the Senadores de Caracas of the Venezuelan Major League.
